name: keboola
description: Explore, query and build in your Keboola projects: inspect tables, run SELECT queries, create SQL transformations and flows, and debug failed jobs through the Keboola MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your Keboola projects. Explore buckets and tables, query data with read-only SQL, build Snowflake or BigQuery SQL transformations, orchestrate them in flows, and find out why a job failed. You log in with your Keboola account, pick the projects to work on, and every change is made only in the project you confirm.
defaultPrompt: Show me the tables in my Keboola project and what they contain.
Create a SQL transformation that aggregates daily orders.
Why did my last Keboola job fail?
